issues.description: Field RollerCoaster.numberOfLoopings: The problem statement UML (RollerCoaster class) declares numberOfLoopings as type int, but the solution implementation declares a private field numberOfLoopings of type long and provides getNumberOfLoopings() returning long. This mismatch (int in the UML vs long in the solution) can confuse students about which type to implement and may cause tests or expectations to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the type across artifacts. Preferred: change the solution implementation to use int for the numberOfLoopings field and its getter (i.e., private int numberOfLoopings; public int getNumberOfLoopings()). Alternatively, update the UML/problem statement to specify numberOfLoopings: long if long is intended. Ensure tests and constructor signatures are updated accordingly.
